subject.title: feat: retain iMessage tombstones and revisions

question: Should existing `imsgcrawl sync` archives switch from replacement semantics to merge-by-default retention, with destructive replacement moved behind `--restore`?
rationale: This is a user-visible archive and upgrade contract change; tests can verify either mode but cannot determine which default current users should receive.

options.title: Keep replacement as default
options.body: Retain current refresh semantics and introduce merge retention only behind an explicit opt-in after focused migration and compatibility tests.

options.title: Approve merge by default
options.body: Adopt the new retention model only with clear release documentation and fresh-install plus upgrade proof showing how users intentionally discard retained rows.

recommendation.title: Keep replacement as default
recommendation.body: Retain current refresh semantics and introduce merge retention only behind an explicit opt-in after focused migration and compatibility tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The proposed contract and the related archive implementation commits are attributed to this contributor; the choice needs explicit product sponsorship.
